svg.title: Cumulative USDE volume as a multiple of the freely tradable shares, June 26 to October 8, 2026
svg.desc: Line chart. From June 26 to October 8, 2026, USDE traded 380,773,054 shares, 19.97 times the 19,063,653 shares the resale prospectus counted as freely tradable on August 28. The largest single sessions were July 2 with 50,854,315 shares, 2.67 times the count, August 21 with 98,971,190 shares, 5.19 times the count, August 27 with 21,667,372 shares, 1.14 times the count.
